CheckTitle: AWS KMS CMKs found being multi-region
Description: AWS Key Management Service (KMS) Customer Managed Keys (CMKs) have been found to have multi-region enabled.
Risk: Sharing keys across regions could result in decryption of related keys in said regions, along with complicating their management and auditing.

Recommendation.Text: Make sure to to use multi-region keys unless deemed necessary as per business requirements.
